economic_hypothesis: When an entire board has already been under sustained pressure, a stock that preserved a non-negative twenty-session return and at least twelve percentage points of relative strength has revealed stock-specific demand. Its first high-location, participation-confirmed close above the preceding twenty-session high may begin independent price discovery after weak holders have already sold into the board decline.

causal_state.board_stress: At the session immediately before the signal, the same-board cross-sectional median 20-session return is <= -5%.
causal_state.stress_persistence: At least 5 of the 10 completed sessions immediately before the signal have same-board median 20-session return <= -5%.
causal_state.stock_resilience: At the session immediately before the signal, stock 20-session return is >= 0% and exceeds the same-board median 20-session return by >= 12 percentage points.
causal_state.continuous_trading: Every row in the preceding 20-session window is hard-valid, current-valid and tradable, and those 20 rows span no more than 30 market-session indices, excluding suspension-generated flat records and stale post-suspension reappearances.
causal_state.compact_inventory: Across the preceding 20 completed symbol sessions, minimum coordinate low divided by maximum coordinate high is >= 85%, so resilience is a compact holding range rather than a deep-collapse rebound.

trigger.breakout: Completed signal-session corporate-action-coordinate close is strictly above every coordinate high in the preceding 20 completed symbol sessions.
trigger.participation: Signal-session turnover fraction is >= its mean over the preceding 20 completed symbol sessions.
trigger.close_location: Signal-session close location within the daily range is >= 70%; zero-range sessions are assigned 100%.
trigger.not_limit_up: Signal-session coordinate close is strictly below the legal upper-limit coordinate.
trigger.event_deduplication: Retain the first qualifying event per symbol when qualifying events are more than 20 calendar-session indices apart; no future information is used.

decision_at: signal session close after all state and trigger fields are completed
entry: next legal executable session open; never fill on the signal bar
profile_selection: Use 2014-2018 only; maximize median annual mean net trade return, then pooled mean, then shorter holding period.
confirmation: Apply the single frozen profile unchanged to 2019, 2020, and 2021 and require positive annual mean net trade return in each year, pooled mean net trade return >3%, >=50 completed trades/year on average, and no single discovery year as the sole source of the edge.
prohibited: no 2022-2023 until Development rule is frozen and passes
